notes: E1 confirmed: issue #298 states branch ros2 / commit c052be03 and shows the startup refusal; the downstream maintainer's attribution (rt-net PR #153) corroborates a usb_cam change. E2 stop_step 6 (parameter) is correct: usb_cam's video_device parameter now rejects a udev-symlink path; the breakage comes from the provider change (commit af45135d "Check if given v4l2 device exists before opening it", verified), which the consumer must follow — not deployment_wiring. The failed-condition class representation_convention is the best available fit (symlink path form vs canonical /dev/videoN form of the same device value; the parameter's declare_parameter line is unchanged). Loudness loud_documented/activate is exactly the RCLCPP_ERROR_STREAM refusal + "Shutting down" added in af45135d. Resolution observed is backed by the reporter's posted realpath line and issue closure. I note the spec's honest handling: the resolved launch file uses a demo /dev/video0 value before realpath, and the same fix was independently tested on a different consumer (sciurus17_ros) without a stated usb_cam revision.
